test_train_dqn: test the DQNTest.test_train method to train a BoltzmannDQN agent on a simple EFG game and verify total reward
create_boltzmann_dqn_agent: create a BoltzmannDQN agent with configurable hidden layers, replay buffer, epsilon decay, and temperature parameters
run_rl_environment_training: run an RL environment loop with a BoltzmannDQN agent using epsilon-greedy exploration over 100 episodes
test_update_prev_q_network: test the agent.update_prev_q_network method to update the previous Q-network after training
create_rl_agent_policy: create an RLAgentPolicy with BoltzmannDQN agent to compute softmax action probabilities for a game state
